judgment_text:
The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

R. Suresh Kumar, J.:— Mr S.A. Johnson, learned counsel appearing for the appellant, on instructions, seeks withdrawal of this writ appeal. He has also made an endorsement to that effect in the Court bundle.

2. In light of the above, the present writ appeal is dismissed as withdrawn. However, there shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, C.M.P. No. 9786 of 2025 is closed.
